description: Lead delegation TaskSpec: a private per-task data contract, not a platform permission or automatic model-enforcement mechanism.

spec_version.description: Exact TaskSpec contract identity; unrelated to the six business-artifact contract versions.

task_id.description: Stable task identity shared by specification, dispatch and receipts.

revision.description: Monotonic revision. A change creates a new file and digest; preserve old revisions.

purpose.description: Bounded goal and necessary background without changing hard constraints.

target_agent_id.description: Actual validated named target Agent; not an inferred UUID or arbitrary worker label.
